accession_roles.GSE58608: RNA-seq, pre-training biopsies of both legs (T1 = leg to be trained, U1 = untrained leg) for 12 subjects; S5.4.p2 notes a baseline subset (n=12) analyzed earlier
accession_roles.GSE60590: RNA-seq, 22 post-training trained-leg biopsies (T2) plus 11 pre-training T1 biopsies of the other 11 subjects
accession_roles.GSE60591: GEO SuperSeries joining GSE58608 + GSE60590 (57 samples); not named in the paper but holds exactly the two cited series
accession_roles.GSE60655: DNA methylation 450K (S5.6.p1); not part of this gene-expression request

assay: bulk RNA-seq, Illumina HiSeq2000, 2x100 bp, vastus lateralis (S5.4.p1, S3.1.p1)
primary_estimand: Within-subject change in trained-leg skeletal-muscle gene expression after 3 months of supervised one-legged endurance knee-extension training: T2 (24 h after last session) vs T1 (pre-training), trained leg (S3.1.p1, S3.1.p2, S5.1.p1, S5.4.p2)
planned_contrasts: T2 vs T1, trained leg, individual and library preparation as covariates (S5.4.p2; paper: 4076 DEGs, S3.1.p2)

factors.library_preparation: covariate named in S5.4.p2; not annotated in GEO

sample_inclusion: 23 sedentary young subjects; biopsies from both legs before and after training (S3.1.p1). RNA-seq DE is trained leg T2 vs T1 (S3.1.p2, S5.4.p2). The untrained leg is an intraindividual control used for physiology and methylation validation, not in the RNA-seq DEG model.
paper_method: edgeR on gene counts after QC, trimming, mapping, PCR-duplicate removal and gene count summarization; model with group (T2 vs T1) + library preparation + individual (S5.4.p2)
enrichment: goseq GO and KEGG (pathview) on DEGs (S5.4.p2, Table S10): oxidative phosphorylation, ECM, angiogenesis themes (S3.5.p1)
